title: Self-Tor affine coordinates agree on restricted ideal tuples under principal localization
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $n\in\mathbf N$, $B=i_*\mathcal O_Z$, $Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}B[0])$ for the fixed derived tensor [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], $N=i^*\ker(i)$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $E=\bigwedge^n N$ [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. For each affine open $U$ of $Y$, put $A_U=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I_U=i.\mathrm{ker}.\mathrm{ideal}(U)$, $O_U=i^{-1}U$, and let $T_U$ be associated-sheaf formation on $\operatorname{Spec}(A_U)$ followed by affine chart restriction, open pushforward, and tensor pullback by $i$. Let $c_U$ be the normalized comparison from the exterior conormal module to $\operatorname{Tor}^{A_U}_n(A_U/I_U,A_U/I_U)$ [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. There exist families of isomorphisms s_U:E|O_U ≅ T_U(source(c_U))|O_U and t_U:T_U(target(c_U))|O_U ≅ Q|O_U. Write φ_U=s_U T_U(c_U) t_U. Let η:ker(i) → i_*i*ker(i) be the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For every affine open U, every affine V with V=D(f) for an element f in Gamma(Y,U), every h:V⊆U, and every tuple b:Fin(n)→Gamma(U,ker(i)), put b_V=b restricted to V. Then the component of φ_U over O_V and the top component of φ_V agree on the wedge of η_V(b_V,j). There is no assertion for arbitrary ideal tuples on V or for a general affine inclusion V⊆U. The coordinate families are shared across all charts.

source.place: Tags 09PQ, 01R3 and 06YH; parent steps 1-2 and the single principal-localization calculation in step 3, restricted to tuples defined on the larger chart.

proof.text: Apply the adopted upstream exterior-power chart on every affine chart. Transport its chart isomorphism and wedge normalization through the canonical exteriorSheafIsoExteriorPower comparison to obtain the required exterior-sheaf family s. Apply exists_selfTor_target_basic_localization for the target family t and its localization equation on explicit algebraic Tor elements.

For b on U and V contained in U, exterior_section_map and naturality of the original tensor-pullback unit identify the wedge of the restricted unit sections with the restriction of its wedge on U. Naturality of s_U gives conormal_wedge_coordinate_restrict. Rewrite its top value by the source normalization; also normalize s_V on the restricted tuple.

Expand the component of the composite phi. Naturality of T_U(c_U) moves that map past restriction. selfTorAffineSection_map identifies its value on the explicit source section with the explicit section of c_U(w_U(b)); the same lemma handles V. The target localization equation now gives the exact requested equality. The chart families, hypotheses and conclusion stay unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_basic_ideal_wedge_selfTor_coordinates
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n
    let T := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    let c := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      selfTorConormalComparison (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    ∃ (s : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
      (t : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ Q.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      let φ := fun U ↦ (s U).hom ≫ ((T U).map (c U)).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≫ (t U).hom
      let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
      let η := (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
        i.ker.toModules
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1)
        (b : Fin n → i.ker.toModules.val.obj (op U.1)),
        (φ U).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (i.preimage_mono h))))
            (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection N n (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
              (fun j ↦ η.val.app (op V.1)
                (i.ker.toModules.val.map (homOfLE h).op (b j)))) =
          (φ V).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1))))
            (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection N n (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
              (fun j ↦ η.val.app (op V.1)
                (i.ker.toModules.val.map (homOfLE h).op (b j))))
